description:
Implement InfluxDB adapter for BenchBox to support time series benchmarking workloads.

InfluxDB 3.x is a time series database built on Apache Arrow, DataFusion, and Parquet
(the FDAP stack). It supports native SQL queries via FlightSQL protocol, making it
a good fit for BenchBox's SQL-based benchmarking approach.

Primary use case: Running TSBS (Time Series Benchmark Suite) DevOps workloads against
InfluxDB to benchmark time series query performance alongside other platforms like
ClickHouse, TimescaleDB, and DuckDB.
